svg.title: Vmette architecture
svg.desc: An agent host talks to Vmette over MCP. Untrusted work runs in a hardware-isolated Linux microVM on the macOS host, with its own kernel. Only named directories are shared; network stays off until requested.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Native host tools still run on the Mac unless you restrict them.
